Thanks for the ping. We do have a pilot PO-waiver workflow we use for early-stage pilots (<= $25k) that requires:
- Finance review (cost center signoff)
- A Director-level approval from Sales Ops (to accept net-30)
- Signed waiver attached to vendor file

I'll review the specifics for Clark Tech but preliminary SLA is 48 business hours once we have:
1) Completed vendor_onboarding_form.pdf
2) Proof of identity / W-9 or equivalent (for US entities)
3) PO-waiver signed by the buyer (Clark Tech)

If Clark Tech agrees to milestone invoicing and we'll cap cumulative exposure at $20k for the pilot, I can fast-track Finance review and route to Sales Ops for the director sign-off.

Action items for Soojin: please have Emily complete the onboarding form and return a buyer-signed waiver (I can prefill our waiver template). I'll prepare the internal approval packet and drop the signed version in the vendor folder.

- If Clark Tech requests an extended payment term (>30 days) we should require a PO or escalate to Finance Director.

I'll confirm director-level availability; if Laura starts the packet I can sign by end of day Monday.

Next steps:
- I attached the onboarding form and the waiver template. Please sign the waiver (buyer signature) and upload both to the shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1X_sample_onboarding_folder
- I'll route the completed packet for internal approvals (Laura and Karthik are on copy). Expect a signed waiver back to you within 48 business hours after we receive the completed docs.

We can begin technical onboarding immediately; billing will be on milestone invoices as discussed. If that's acceptable, please return the completed PDF and W-9 and I'll kick approvals.
